title: pump.fun new token monitor input
description: How long to watch, how many tokens to keep, and which of them you care about.

durationSecs.title: Watch for (seconds)
durationSecs.description: How long the run listens to the chain. 90 by default (an automated platform check expects the whole run under five minutes, and a container restart eats a minute); 3600 is one hour. The run stops itself at this limit and says so in the summary. If the platform gives the run less time than this (ACTOR_TIMEOUT_AT), the window is shortened to fit and the summary says durationCappedByPlatform.

maxTokens.title: Stop after this many tokens
maxTokens.description: Hard stop on delivered rows. 0 means no limit and the run ends by duration only.

minDevBuyPercent.title: Creator bought at least (% of supply)
minDevBuyPercent.description: Keep only tokens where the creator bought this share of the total supply in the creation transaction. 0 keeps every token. A creator who bought nothing has devBuyTokens 0 and devBuyPercent 0.

maxDevBuyPercent.title: Creator bought at most (% of supply)
maxDevBuyPercent.description: Drop tokens where the creator grabbed more than this share at birth. 100 keeps every token.

onlyNewCreators.title: Only creators new in this run
onlyNewCreators.description: Keep a token only if this run has not already seen another launch by the same creator address. This is history inside the run, not the creator's whole on-chain past: chain-wide history is planned, not promised here.

nameContains.title: Name contains
nameContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the token name. Empty keeps everything.

symbolContains.title: Symbol contains
symbolContains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the token symbol. Empty keeps everything.

includeDevBuy.title: Read the creator's buy from the transaction
includeDevBuy.description: One RPC call per token to read the creator's token balance change in the creation transaction. With this off, devBuyTokens and devBuyPercent stay null (not zero: unknown is not the same as nothing) and the filters above cannot be applied, so the run says so and keeps every token.

rpcUrl.title: Your own Solana HTTP RPC (optional)
rpcUrl.description: Use your own endpoint to avoid the public rate limit. Empty means the public https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com.

rpcWsUrl.title: Your own Solana websocket RPC (optional)
rpcWsUrl.description: Websocket endpoint for live logs. Empty means the public wss://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com, which drops connections under load; the actor then keeps working by polling the HTTP endpoint and marks those rows source poll. The fallback samples the stream and says how much it missed in the summary.

rpcPaceSecs.title: Seconds between RPC calls
rpcPaceSecs.description: Minimum pause between two RPC calls. The default 2.5 is the only interval measured to pass the public endpoint cleanly (0.3 s earned 429 within ten calls). A paid endpoint of your own takes 0.1 or less, and then the HTTP fallback covers far more of the stream.
